about_the_game:
About this DEMO

In the Whisker Kingdom, almost all cats have been turned into stone by the terrible Miaudusa. Now, only the young apprentices Nino and Nina can break the spell by preparing magical potions capable of bringing the petrified felines back to life.

Miautemágica is a cooperative game where math and teamwork blend into a cute and challenging adventure. Play with a friend and discover together how to use fractions and percentages to create the potions that will save the Whisker Kingdom!

Cooperation is Key

Each potion is a unique challenge that demands communication and reasoning. One player handles fractions (solid ingredients), while the other masters percentages (liquid ingredients).

To complete the recipes, you will need to think fast, communicate, and get the measurements right. If you miss the measurements, your friends in the kingdom will be turned into cockroaches!

Math-magic in Action

This demo features the first stage of Nino and Nina's journey against the terrible Miaudusa, where learning happens in a light and fun way.

Designed for duo play, whether among friends, family, or even in the classroom, Miautemágica transforms the study of fractions and percentages into a cooperative and enchanting experience.

What’s Included in This Demo

  • Magical maps with increasing difficulty.

  • Local cooperative mode, where players split the same screen.

  • An explanatory and complete introductory tutorial with Nino and Nina.

  • Simple controls and intuitive interface for all ages.

  • Practical challenges that magically combine fractions and percentages.

  • Boss battle against Miaudusa, the villain who petrified the kingdom's cats.

  • Practice fractions and percentages in practical and magical challenges.

  • Battle Miaudusa in a boss fight.

short_description: Miautemágica is an educational, local co-op 3D game. Two apprentice cat alchemists work together, brewing magical potions to save the Whisker Kingdom from the terrible Meowdusa. Each potion challenges logical reasoning with fractions and percentages. Collaborate and learn!
